title: When Should Agents Check External State? Budgeting Observations for Stored Intentions
abstract: arXiv:2609.37125v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prospective memory allows an agent to retain an intention tied to a future condition, but the stored intention does not reveal whether that condition currently holds. Checking it may require web access, multi-step tool use, and paid calls. Existing systems decide when intentions require attention, but do not allocate the resulting observations under a shared budget. We introduce the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget. BudgetPM offers two policy variants that share a hard-budget executor. BudgetPM-Static uses a lightweight Logistic scorer to learn whether a check improves the current decision. BudgetPM-Sequential distills full-episode hindsight schedules into a lightweight policy that decides when to spend or reserve capacity using only pre-query information at deployment. translated_title: 智能体应何时检查外部状态？为存储意图分配观测预算
translated_abstract: 前瞻记忆使智能体能够保留一个与未来条件相关联的意图，但存储的意图并不能揭示该条件当前是否成立。检查该条件可能需要网络访问、多步工具使用和付费调用。现有系统可以决定意图何时需要关注，但并未在共享预算下分配由此产生的观测。我们提出了首个针对共享回合预算下、存储意图所需外部观测的资源分配形式化方法。BudgetPM 提供了两个共享硬预算执行器的策略变体：BudgetPM-Static 使用轻量级 Logistic 评分器来学习一次检查是否有助于改善当前决策；BudgetPM-Sequential 将完整回合的事后调度蒸馏为一个轻量级策略，在部署时仅利用查询前的信息来决定何时花费或保留预算容量。我们针对两个公开的记忆智能体系统和五个匹配的基线方法对 BudgetPM 进行了评估。
tldr: 本文首次将智能体为验证存储意图所需的外部观测形式化为共享预算下的资源分配问题，并提出 BudgetPM 框架（包含静态评分器与序列策略两种变体）来决定何时花费或保留观测预算。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first resource-allocation formulation for the external observations required by stored intentions under a shared episode budget, and proposes BudgetPM, with static and sequential policy variants, to decide when to spend or reserve observation budget.
